status: Expired-rotation control release implemented for the existing scoped SmartAI actors. Native-function regressions, canonical Release verification and startup pass; client controls/portrait remain unverified.

correction.previousAssumption: The previous audit/conversation attributed this normal charm gap to replacement of the actor's AI.
correction.actualPath: Unit::SetCharmedBy calls the current AI's OnCharmed(true). CreatureAI::OnCharmed requests an AI change and disables AI, but SmartAI overrides that method and only dispatches SMART_EVENT_CHARMED. These four templates retain SmartAI, and have no charm-event rows. Ordinary charm/possession/conversion therefore retains npc_grey_shoals_rotation; it does not normally invoke the replacement path assumed earlier.
correction.observedRegression: Executing the pinned f9bc6062 script with the same native charm functions shows an inactive hidden/passive actor still holding its charm GUID, charmer control relation and aura. The missing operation is native uncontrol, not a required global AI-selection change.
correction.boundary: Native-function fixture reproduction, not an observed live-client failure. Full spell target/immunity admission and native aura storage are not executed.

implementation.scope: Only the existing Grey Shoals DB-spawn SmartAI wrapper: entries115025/115026/115031/115751 on1220 with DB home area8297. No global charm/AI dispatch changes, SQL migration or character-data changes.
implementation.behavior: Before Sync's unchanged-state return, an inactive actor removes its native charm/possession/AOE-charm auras. If a direct/scripted charm remains without an aura, RemoveCharmedBy(nullptr) uses the actual charmer relationship to release it. Clear LastCharmerGUID so an expired actor cannot retain a later auto-attack target. Force the passive/nonattackable gate again after control cleanup, which can restore a saved react state.
implementation.nativeCleanup: Delegate to existing RemoveCharmAuras -> native aura handlers -> RemoveCharmedBy and SetCharm(false). Preserve native faction restoration, control GUID/set cleanup, action-bar removal, possession client-control orders and primary minion relationship. Do not manually rewrite player mover/charm fields or delete the actor/pet.
implementation.nativeCharmInfoBoundary: The player-uncontrol branch sends RemoveControlBar and can retain CharmInfo; the regression intentionally preserves that native behavior rather than inventing a deletion. Non-player uncontrol exercises its native DeleteCharmInfo branch, followed by reapplying the inactive gate.
implementation.activeRotation: Control remains while the rotation is active; normal reactivation restores the actor's original react/gate flags without granting progression. Repeated inactive updates are idempotent, and forced control applied while already inactive is released on the next lifecycle update.

actualFunctions: Current production npc_grey_shoals_rotation::Sync and pinned f9bc6062 baseline
nativeTests.bindings: Native aura dispatcher entries2/6/177 are checked against the actual source table. CharmType and ReactStates enums are extracted from Unit.h.
cases: Active charm remains; exact rotation expiry removes normal charm, possession, conversion and direct scripted charm.
An unavailable aura caster is resolved through the still-present charmer relationship by native RemoveCharmedBy(nullptr). This is not a test of a corrupted orphan GUID with no charmer object.
Actual SmartAI charm callback retains the same AI and IsAIEnabled; actual base CreatureAI callback requests a change, proving the distinction behind the corrected assumption.
Native charm GUIDs and controlled-unit set clear, original faction restores, the former-charmer target clears, and possession restores the player's mover/control flags.
A separate permanent pet stays owned/registered and remains GetFirstControlled after charm removal; the unrelated aura survives.
Repeated expiry does not repeat bar/aura cleanup; forced re-control while already inactive is still released; next activation restores react/gate state.
Non-player conversion and missing rotation exercise native CharmInfo cleanup and reapply the passive gate.
nativeTests.baseline: The runner separately compiles the pinned previous script and confirms retained control for all eight player/aura-caster combinations plus NPC conversion, then manually cleans the fixture. The current implementation releases them.
nativeTests.fixtureBoundary: Aura storage/removal scheduling, world/charmer lookup, CharmInfo initialization/state services, spell creation and movement/packet methods are controlled doubles. Actual native application/removal/control-relation functions and production Sync execute. No claim of packet delivery, camera, action-bar rendering or pet portrait verification.

additionalChecks: Test-GreyShoalsRotation.ps1 passes with its no-control fixture; expiry visibility, scaled damage, corpse/respawn/new rotation and ordinary factory isolation remain covered.
Test-CharmCreateSpells.ps1 passes actual initialization for ownerless, owned, guardian and map/level branches.
Test-PetLoadSelection.ps1 passes; permanent-pet lookup code was not changed.
Test-WarlockRegression.ps1 passes, including scripted mover resynchronization and unrelated mover rejection. This is supporting regression coverage, not client confirmation.

Standard CMake Release worldserver/bnetserver build passes. Test-GreyShoalsRelease.ps1 verifies actual final-link inputs, deployed native visibility/lifecycle slots and scoped Sync calls to both RemoveCharmAuras and RemoveCharmedBy.

release.configuration: Canonical runtime data/configuration/certificates/DLLs preserved. Validation server shut down gracefully.

remaining: Client: stationary expiry while controlling a Grey Shoals NPC, action bar, possession camera/mover restoration, primary pet portrait and next rotation.
Artificial AI replacement, manually disabled AI, GM-forced kills or corrupted/orphaned control fields are not claimed covered by this ordinary native SmartAI control path.
Earlier audits' exact placement, baseline fauna, native combat target execution, terrain/navmesh and visual timing findings remain open. This fix does not mark the entire quest client-verified.
